chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Why Hot Lips never broke through; an organ record date
summary: Dance asks why Lips never made it; Ramirez recalls making a date with Lips on organ.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: But I take it with Hot Lips, he was the chief attraction at that time, was he?
Yeah, well, he went on his own.
He never quite broke through, did he.
No. He gave up the band, and he went... He did a solo. He went back to Europe for the festivals, you know.
Why do you think Lips never made it? I mean, his singing was good and...
Do you think he was just too personal?
I don't remember what he died from. I made a record with him and... Willie The Lion couldn't make it. Who was the first Hammond organ player? What was his name? The White...
I don't know. There was that fellow that Lionel got, Johnny Dukes or something.
Oh, I see your point. You, Lips and the organ.
Yes. I made a date out of that. I never heard the records. Anyway...
